notes.title: Story Chapter III!
notes.notes:
[h1]Chapter III[/h1]
It took some time for me to finally release this update and I hope that You will have a nice time playing it! 
Let's jump into the most important features of this update!
[h2]New Content![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/9b75df631222a275dab143f9e8f1751b4f0cc9c1.png[/img]
Compared to Story 2.0 there is approximately 3 times the content, by which I mean plenty of new locations, characters, interactions, dialogue for you to uncover! And after all of that, there are 8 unique endings with small cutscenes waiting for you.
[h2]Two Bosses![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/d39ed00ea93f8189cdc5f6021b76910adb532c91.png[/img]
Two new bosses with unique abilities were added to the game!
[h2]Improved Combat![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/022566c0187065e48e1a88b304f79523d1c4661b.png[/img]
All combat mechanics were reworked with new animations, sound effects and visual effects leading into more responsive combat with better feedback of every player and enemy action. 
[h2]Improved Gameplay![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/5332953da38b966ea1d98bf8c753aaed48bb91a1.png[/img]
Gameplay overall received a lot of improvements, one of which is the active effects system. Active effects affect your character in various ways, ranging from increasing your stamina to making your body bigger! Logs in the upper-left corner of the screen will now help You understand your interactions with the game world.
[h2]Improved Level Art![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/e23a9e867da50a489875a42058fa73ff862c9529.png[/img]
Besides new levels, older levels were reworked, so they create a better and much more immersive experience!
[h2]And much more![/h2]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
Story was quite a journey for me but now it's time to move on. Making games is great, nonetheless it has some downfalls. I will probably make some other game in this universe but I cannot say anything for sure because I've got to work on it in my spare time which isn't much at all. My only hope is that You will have fun playing it :)

Waiting for Your feedback,
Błażej Smorawski

notes.title: Story Rework Update 2.0!
notes.notes:
Story, a year ago was not the game you - player deserved to play, so I decided to rework it into a much better experience.
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/f4c31f0758a2ec70a58ec7fa426a80a2d3a5fac6.png[/img]
Almost every aspect of the game was reworked, so you may not see many similarities with the previous version but the core of the gameplay which is exploration and player-driven narrative, stays in its' place. There's also a new Golden Gang supporter skin if you would like to help me a little.
[h1]Visuals[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/8ff147a526dd1ce04a66d85d167a9d0097b33693.png[/img]
All visual elements from the game were designed again with new art direction in mind and much improved readability.
[h1]Combat[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/f012e7e96d903f53db58d2a402f396f9bdcfbd8a.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]New, more responsive animations
[*]Much better AI
[*]Completely new companion system
[*]And much more left for you to discover!
[/list]
[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Today, only the first chapter of Story 2.0 was released. I wanted to release it that way, because I wanted to hear your  feedback and address it in upcoming updates. If you would like to share any thoughts on Story, do it here or on our Discord channel [url=https://discord.com/invite/WrpQ6nY]here[/url].

Regards,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/e2db29cfc7368ab4e522e2a3d6b99d21c0cdb430.png[/img]

notes.title: Story Update 1.1!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

Thanks for playing Story! Huge thanks to the first Golden Gang member! 

First of all, let's have look at statistics:

[list]
[*]40,697 copies of Story in your libraries
[*]342 unique players
[*]22 average daily players
[*]1 GOLDEN GANG MEMBER
[/list]

It looks like we are going forward and reaching bigger audience. Thanks for giving my game a shot :D

[h2]Changelog 1.1[/h2]

Story 1.1 is quite different from version released month ago. I tried to improve every aspect of it based on your great feedback and keep it soul as it was. It was quite a lot of work for me and I the only thought I have on my mind is sleep. Here's list of the changes:

[olist]
[*]Added FULL gamepad support
[*]Improved camera
[*]Reworked combat (everyone dies from one hit)
[*]Added a plenty of new enemies
[*]Added save points 
[*]Added system of essences which makes gameplay more interesting and fun
[*]Reworked almost all animations
[*]Increased speed of all characters
[*]Added small tutorial
[*]Decreased strength of volumetric fog effect
[*]Geometry will not cover your character any more
[*]Removed ability to speed up time flow 
[*]And a lot more smaller tweaks!
[/olist]


[h2]What's next?[/h2]

As I said, I'd like to implement multiplayer to Story - both PvE and PvP, more overall content but I cannot tell if it will happen in the nearest future because earning 5$ in the first month is quite disappointing and it will not allow me to work on Story full-time for the next months, so I've got to find different day-time job than developing Story and maybe work on it in my spare time. 

I hope you will have a great time with Story 1.1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38080891/e2db29cfc7368ab4e522e2a3d6b99d21c0cdb430.png[/img]

notes.title: Short message from the dev
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow storytellers![/h1]

[h2]First of all, Thanks for playing Story![/h2]

On 2th of July I released the game I've been working on since September 2019. It meant a lot for me but let's have a look at the numbers.

[h3] 
[olist]
[*]2,525 copies are in your libraries
[*]63 people played the game, most from USA
[*]8 average daily active users
[/olist]
[/h3]

It may not seem like a lot but it is very important for me. I want to thank you for giving Story a chance and I hope you had nice time with the game. I'm very sorry if you did not enjoy it, I tried my best. If you would like to support me a little you can become the first member of Golden Gang by buying Golden Gang Supporter skin for your main character. I'd be pleased to hear stories you created. If you want to share them, send them to contact@storythegame.com or write them in comments.

[h2]Have a nice day!
Błażej Smorawski[/h2]
